### breakingDam3d

The example `breakingDam3d` extends the `breakingDam2d` example to 3D.
A full simulation run of the `breakingDam3d` example, visualized in ParaView, can be found on the $\OpenLB$ YouTube page (<https://youtu.be/X8yeLCkUldQ>).
